reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and I do not buy supplements on faith. A named independent lab with a batch report I can check is the first time I would try one, and $24.99 for one box is a small test.
objection: A named lab does not tell me the lab is any good, and the product is made in China. I would still want my doctor to be fine with 200 mg a day.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me not to take extra magnesium, or a batch report that did not match the number on the box.
